name: 13998-prefillheavy-235ba22b-tp8
parallelism: TP=8, EP=1 (expert parallelism off), PP=1, DP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM, 94 decoder layers, hidden 4096, 64 attention heads over 4 KV heads at head_dim 128, 128 routed experts top-8, vocab 151936, bf16 with no quantization config. ~470 GB of safetensors, ~58.8 GB per card at TP8.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 1500 requests with a 900 s safety cap -- ~1350 measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN: 500 prompt tokens in, 100 output tokens out, both exact with no spread, no prefix buckets and no prefix reuse. `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0`, so all 100 output tokens are produced.
purpose: A large mixture-of-experts assistant answering 500-token single-turn prompts with short replies for 32 concurrent users on eight GPUs.
launch:
# Eight GPUs of one node serving Qwen3-235B-A22B in bf16 under eight-way tensor parallelism,
# 32 requests in flight, 500 prompt tokens in and 100 generated out.

# ~470 GB of safetensors, ~58.8 GB per card at TP8 against 80 GB cards. Not in the local HF
# cache -- it downloads once before the first launch.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B

tp-size: 8

# Pinned: this commit's default backend on an H100 is not necessarily flashinfer, and an
# unpinned backend would make a different baseline.
attention-backend: flashinfer

# Load-bearing for the workload: with the radix cache on, synthetic prompts that happen to share
# a leading span are served from cache and skip part of the prompt they were meant to process.
disable-radix-cache: true

# Left unset, this commit derives 512 on an 80 GB card at tp>=4 and captures ~66 graph rungs --
# minutes of startup and gigabytes of graph buffer for batch sizes a 32-stream closed loop never
# reaches. 32 is itself a rung of the generated ladder, so nothing falls out of the graph.
cuda-graph-max-bs: 32
